create.title: New character
create.unattached_one: {{count}} lorebook couldn't be attached. Attach it from the character's settings.
create.unattached_other: {{count}} lorebooks couldn't be attached. Attach them from the character's settings.
create.discardBody: What you entered so far is lost.

identity.title: Who is it
identity.body: A name and a face. Everything else can come later.
identity.name: Name
identity.nameHint: Shown in chats and on their card
identity.cardStyleBody: How the character looks on Chats
identity.bannerBody: Used on banner cards. Falls back to the avatar.
identity.gradientBody: Choose how the card is tinted
identity.previewDescription: The first sentence of the definition shows here.
identity.importBody: Import a PNG, UEC or JSON character card.
identity.roleplayBody: Scene-driven chats, narrative framing and starting scenarios.
identity.companionBody: Relationship-driven chats with emotional state and companion memory.

details.title: Who they are
details.body: The definition is what the model reads. Be specific about personality, voice and background.
details.definitionPlaceholder: Personality, speaking style, background, what they know
details.definitionHint: Use {{char}} for the character and {{user}} for your persona.
details.descriptionPlaceholder: A short line for cards and lists
details.descriptionHint: Optional. Not sent to the model.
details.modelMissing: A model that no longer exists
details.memoryBody: Manual notes, or summaries the app keeps
details.promptMissing: A prompt that no longer exists
details.modelHint: Which model answers as this character
details.memoryDynamicBody: Remembers what matters on its own
details.memoryDynamicOff: Turn on dynamic memory in settings to use it

scenes.title: Where it starts
scenes.body: Each scene is a way a chat can begin. The default one is used when you don't pick.
scenes.emptyBody: Add a scene, or skip to details.
scenes.textPlaceholder: *{{char}} looks up from the map.* "You're late."
scenes.directionHint: Optional guidance for how this scene unfolds.
scenes.selectBody: Choose a scene to edit its opening message.
scenes.deleteBody: {{scene}} and its opening message will be deleted.
scenes.emptyWarningBody: Empty scenes will be skipped when you create this character. Add an opening message to keep them.
scenes.emptyBodyEdit: Add a scene to give chats a way to begin.
scenes.emptyWarningBodyEdit: Empty scenes will be skipped when you save. Add an opening message to keep them.

extras.title: Extras
extras.body: Everything here is optional. Skip it and the character still works.
extras.nicknameHint: Used in chats instead of the name
extras.creator: Creator
extras.creatorNotesPlaceholder: Tips or context for whoever uses this character
extras.lorebooksEmptyBody: Lorebooks you create or import show up here.

pickers.modelDefaultBody: Whatever model the app uses by default
pickers.noModels: No models yet. Add one in Settings.
pickers.promptDefaultBody: The app's default for this kind of chat

edit.title: Character
edit.lorebooksFailed: Saved, but the lorebooks could not be updated. Try saving again.
edit.leaveBody: Changes that are not saved are lost.

voice.title: Voice
voice.noProviders: No audio providers yet. Add one in Settings.
voice.autoplayBody: Plays each reply as it arrives

essence.label: Essence
essence.placeholder: Who they are underneath the card definition

appearance.placeholder: How they look and carry themselves

soul.affectBody: How they feel by default, before anything happens
soul.regulationBody: How they handle and show what they feel

soul.styleNotesHint: How their replies should read. Added to the companion prompt.

generateSoul.title: Generate from character
generateSoul.body: Drafts a soul from the name, definition and scenes. You review it before anything changes.
generateSoul.directionPlaceholder: Lean tsundere: guarded outside, soft once trusted. Less anxious, more pride.

generateSoul.usingModel: Uses {{model}}. You review and edit before applying.
generateSoul.failed: The soul could not be generated.
generateSoul.facts_one: {{count}} authored fact comes with the identity.
generateSoul.facts_other: {{count}} authored facts come with the identity.
